data.value: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?

The town of Riverton has 19,000 residents. The petition against the quarry extension needs 1,500 signatures to trigger a council debate. The submission deadline is six weeks from the start date, i.e., 2026-09-14. The organizers have already collected 400 signatures. The quarry operator distributed a counter-flyer last week.
